# Serverino

> Serverino is a zero-dependency, multi-process HTTP and WebSocket server library for the D programming language. It uses a daemon/worker process model (epoll on Linux, kqueue on macOS/BSD, select elsewhere) for resilience against crashes and slow-client attacks, and a UDA-based API for routing and configuration. Version 0.7.21.

Endpoints are plain functions annotated with `@endpoint`; the server is started by mixing in `ServerinoMain`. Workers are separate processes, not threads: no application state is shared between requests.

```d
import serverino;
mixin ServerinoMain;

@endpoint
void hello(Request request, Output output) {
    output ~= "Hello, Serverino!";
}
```

## Docs

- [Consolidated reference for LLMs](https://trikko.github.io/serverino/llms-full.txt): Complete API reference, patterns and pitfalls in a single file. Start here.
- [serverino.config](https://trikko.github.io/serverino/serverino/config.html): UDAs (`@endpoint`, `@route`, `@priority`, lifecycle hooks) and the `ServerinoConfig` fluent API.
- [serverino.interfaces](https://trikko.github.io/serverino/serverino/interfaces.html): `Request`, `Output`, `Cookie`, `WebSocket`, `WebSocketMessage`, `ServerinoProcess`.
- [API index](https://trikko.github.io/serverino/): Generated ddox documentation.

## Examples

- [All examples](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples): Compiled in CI, so always in sync with the current API.
- [Hello world](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/01_hello_world): Minimal server.
- [Forms and file uploads](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/03_form): `request.post` and `request.form`.
- [WebSocket echo](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/05_websocket_echo): `@onWebSocketUpgrade` plus a `(Request, WebSocket)` endpoint.
- [WebSocket callbacks](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/07_websocket_callback): `ws.onTextMessage` and friends.
- [Sessions](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/09_simple_session): Cookie handling across a multi-process server.
- [HTTPS with SNI](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/tree/master/examples/12_https): Experimental; requires the `https` dub subconfiguration and POSIX.

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/trikko/serverino): Source, issues and README.
- [Wiki: tips and tricks](https://github.com/trikko/serverino/wiki/): Recipes beyond the API reference.
- [dub package](https://code.dlang.org/packages/serverino): `dub add serverino`.
